defeat.journal.01.text: A setback is just a setback with better lighting.

defeat.journal.02.text: Get back up. The mountain is terrible at keeping score.

defeat.journal.03.text: If at first you don't succeed, invent a reason you meant to fall.

defeat.journal.04.text: Courage is continuing after you've already explained yourself to the floor.

defeat.journal.05.text: Pack light regrets. They bruise less than heavy ones.

defeat.journal.06.text: Always map the exit before the entrance. I never did. Look how wise I sound.

defeat.journal.07.text: A monster that beats you once has taught you its name. Charge interest later.

defeat.journal.08.text: Sleep on it. The bruise will still be there; you'll just be ruder to it.

defeat.journal.09.text: Luck prefers the prepared. I preferred lunch. We compromised.

defeat.journal.10.text: When the wheel goes quiet, listen for your own breathing. Then ignore it and try again.

defeat.journal.11.text: Never trust a corridor that smiles. Corridors should not have opinions.

defeat.journal.12.text: Defeat is temporary. Embarrassment is archival. File yours under "research."

defeat.journal.13.text: Bring biscuits for {nib}. Bring stubbornness for yourself. Priorities.

defeat.journal.14.text: The mountain keeps what you drop. So don't drop your nerve.

defeat.journal.15.text: A good plan survives contact. A great plan apologizes and revises.

defeat.journal.16.text: If you can still limp, you can still learn. Limping is underrated scholarship.

defeat.journal.17.text: Hold the Block for the thing that laughs. Everything else is practice.

defeat.journal.18.text: Counting to four is plenty. Beyond that is showing off.

defeat.journal.19.text: Home is where the Cabinet is. The Cabinet is where the proof is.

defeat.journal.20.text: Do not open the left-hand drawer. That advice has outlived me. Heed it.

defeat.journal.21.text: Falling with style still counts as falling. Falling with notes counts as science.

defeat.journal.22.text: The belly of the mountain has no manners. Reply in kind, then leave.

defeat.journal.23.text: Your pockets are finite. Your next attempt is not.

defeat.journal.24.text: Whisper a vow, then shout a Spin. Order matters.

defeat.journal.25.text: I met every brick in this place personally. Some of them remember fondly.

defeat.journal.26.text: Tips from the deceased: stay curious, stay greedy, stay vaguely upright.

defeat.journal.27.text: A trophy unbanked is a story unfinished. Finish loudly next time.

defeat.journal.28.text: If the lantern goes out, you still have spite. Spite is a renewable resource.

defeat.journal.29.text: Never apologize to a boulder. It will take it personally and roll.

defeat.journal.30.text: Soft moss is a trap. Hard stone is honesty. Prefer honesty, briefly.

defeat.journal.31.text: The will said everything. It did not say "easily." Fine print of the heart.

defeat.journal.32.text: Dust yourself off with dignity, or with a rag. I prefer the rag. It's honest.

defeat.journal.33.text: One more delve. Always one more. That is the whole religion.

defeat.journal.34.text: Monsters improve you. You improve the furniture. Fair trade.

defeat.journal.35.text: Keep your heels pointed homeward even when your head is pointed elsewhere.

defeat.journal.36.text: A quiet bell helps. A quieter ego helps more. I mastered neither.

defeat.journal.37.text: Write the bruise down. Future you will call it foreshadowing.

defeat.journal.38.text: The Spin does not care about your feelings. Charm it anyway.

defeat.journal.39.text: Bank early. Brag later. Bragging early is how I met the floor.

defeat.journal.40.text: If you see a shortcut, assume it sees you first.

defeat.journal.41.text: Hunger is a strategy. So is soup. I endorse soup.

defeat.journal.42.text: Stand where the light is thin and your luck is thick.

defeat.journal.43.text: The engraving says how dare you. Wear that energy into the next room.

defeat.journal.44.text: Failure is a footnote. Footnotes are where the truth hides. Congratulations.

defeat.journal.45.text: Leave the mountain something to miss. Preferably not your hat.

defeat.journal.46.text: When in doubt, take the shiny thing and apologize to history.

defeat.journal.47.text: Bones mend. Pride mends slower. Both mend if you keep moving.

defeat.journal.48.text: I died famous for luck. You will live famous for trying. Better deal.

defeat.journal.49.text: The cabin will wait. It always does. It has excellent manners.

defeat.journal.50.text: Close the journal. Open the door. The mountain owes you a rematch.

playtest.intro.01.text:
Hey friends — thanks for playtesting my game, {game_title}.
Just a few notes before you jump in.

playtest.intro.02.text: First. This game is in early prototype mode. The things I most want to hear from your feedback are about what is fun, what is boring, what is confusing, and what things you think I should add to the game.

playtest.intro.03.text: Second. Be honest and picky! You don't need to consider anyone else's perspective. I just want to hear yours.

playtest.intro.04.text: And finally, have fun! Break the game, find cool combos, test the limits. And don't be afraid to dream big with your requests.

playtest.intro.05.text: This is the menu you'll land on.

playtest.intro.06.text: **Brand New** starts from the beginning, as if you had never played.

playtest.intro.07.text: **Middle Progress** puts you a few dungeons in, with some items already unlocked.

playtest.intro.08.text: **Continue** picks up your last playtest save.

playtest.intro.09.text: **Feedback** opens a note to me. Use it for anything that is not tied to one card.

playtest.intro.10.text: You can right-click any item or monster in the game and leave feedback. That is useful for bugs, confusion, or balance issues.

playtest.intro.11.text: For general comments while you play, click **Feedback** in the bottom right, or press **F2**.

playtest.intro.12.text: This is the F2 screen. Type a note, click Send, and it goes to my game development console. Next time I sit down to work, I will see it and can make the fix or the change.

playtest.intro.13.text: However — for those who want to give the best kind of feedback, I would love to actually HEAR your experience.

playtest.intro.14.text: Consider taking your phone, setting it to a voice memo or recorder, and just letting it run while you play. Talk out loud about your thought process, your first impressions, your feedback, anything at all.

playtest.intro.15.text: Then send me the entire file when you are done, because I can turn that into a much more detailed look at your player experience. If you are interested in doing that, you can email the files to me at nathan.elequin@gmail.com.

playtest.intro.16.text: So thank you again for playtesting. If you have any questions, you can always reach out to me. Now enjoy!

splash.biome.cinder_forge.text: Before I saw the Cinder Forge I felt the heat on my face. The stone underfoot was warm, and farther in I heard metal strike and saw sparks drop to the floor. I wiped my brow and kept walking. {grandpa} had come this way before me; I meant to do the same, and to come out again.

tutorial.line.B01-a.1.text: ...and by that, I mean that YOU will need to face them. Sorry kid, I'm no fighter like you.

tutorial.line.B01.1.text: Oh no - an ambush, right on our path to the cabin? Who could've possibly expected this?

tutorial.line.B01.2.text: Well, looks like there's only one way through this mess. We'll have to face these monsters head-on.

tutorial.line.B02.1.text: They've got us surrounded, making this wheel shape. We call this a [b]Dungeon[/b]; if you [color=#4e1c86][b]Defeat[/b][/color] all the enemies here, you get to [color=#7a1212][b]Heal[/b][/color] back to full [color=#7a1212][b]HP[/b][/color] and escape.

tutorial.line.B03.1.text: The GOOD news is that you can see all of your enemies, so you can prepare for them.

tutorial.line.B03.2.text: The BAD news is that you never know who you will be facing next.

tutorial.line.B03.3.text: These dungeons spin, selecting your opponents at random.

tutorial.line.B06.1.text: Spin and fight whoever you land on.

tutorial.line.B08.2.text: That's a hefty hit. He'd nearly kill you in one strike.

tutorial.line.B09.2.text: If you Defeat him first, he'll never get the chance to strike.

tutorial.line.B10.1.text: Let's take a look at your items.

tutorial.line.B10.2.text: The Sai hits for 2 Attack. Click it to Use and Discard it.

tutorial.line.B11.1.text: Good work. Now, watch the [b]Dungeon Deck[/b].

tutorial.line.B11.2.text: When a monster is Defeated, a new card is drawn to replace it.

tutorial.line.B11a.1.text: In each Dungeon, there are 4 additional foes drawn before this deck empties. For now, there's just one more.

tutorial.line.B11aa.1.text: You can always see the next monster to enter the dungeon on top of the deck. Use this to plan ahead, since you may be able to influence where they appear on the wheel.

tutorial.line.B12.1.text: When a monster enters, you gain loot based on the power of that monster.

tutorial.line.B12.3.text: We could use some [color=#0a456e][b]Block[/b][/color]. Take the [b]Shield[/b].

tutorial.line.B14.1.text: This golem has 7 HP. We currently can't deal that much damage.

tutorial.line.B15.2.text: Let's use the Breastplate to block this.

tutorial.line.B16.1.text: This is block. It protects you from incoming attacks.

tutorial.line.B16.2.text: Block lasts until the next Spin, after which it is lost.

tutorial.line.B16.3.text: Now combat isn't over. You can use as many items as you want before clicking this button.

tutorial.line.B17.1.text: For example, you've got this Shield.

tutorial.line.B17.2.text: You COULD use it and take zero damage.

tutorial.line.B17.3.text: However, I recommend you save it instead. And here's why:

tutorial.line.B17.4.text: Hover over the Breastplate to see its ability.

tutorial.line.B17a.1.text: This item says if you lose HP this fight, you get to Keep it.

tutorial.line.B19.1.text: So let's end this fight. You'll take 1 Damage, but it will be worth it.

tutorial.line.B20.1.text: Your block prevented 2 Damage, but you still lost 1 HP.

tutorial.line.B20.2.text: Hang on, there's more. Look at your [b]Spiked Flail's[/b] ability.

tutorial.line.B20.3.text: This item gains +2 Attack every time you lose health. Let's use that to our advantage.

tutorial.line.B20.4.text: Meanwhile, our plan worked. You got to Keep your Breastplate instead of Discarding it.

tutorial.line.B20.5.text: It will be used up like this until after your next Spin - then you can use it again.

tutorial.line.B20.6.text: After a monster Attacks you, they are still Defeated and removed from the board.

tutorial.line.B20.7.text: This means you can defeat enemies in different ways, including attacking them or defending against them.

tutorial.line.B21.1.text: Alright, the final enemy has been drawn from the Dungeon Deck. But when an enemy enters, you get new loot.

tutorial.line.B21.2.text: Take the Fangs. We'll see how it works in a bit.

tutorial.line.B23.1.text: This Goblin doesn't look too dangerous. But wait a second!

tutorial.line.B23.2.text: Hover your mouse over any monster to see their unique ability.

tutorial.line.B24.1.text: This monster is evasive. He is immune to all attacks.

tutorial.line.B25.1.text: However, this item doesn't attack. It defeats anyone with less HP than you.

tutorial.line.B26.1.text: You could use the boot to defeat him right now.

tutorial.line.B26.2.text: Or you could block some of his damage.

tutorial.line.B27a.1.text: Ah, the sweet joy of stomping out your foes. I respect it.

tutorial.line.B27a.2.text: Since you chose to use The Boot, I'll give you a quick tip: if you see a Goblin in a future dungeon, make sure to hold onto a Block or Defeat item. They'll never see it coming.

tutorial.line.B27b.1.text: Ouch. Hurts, doesn't it? Hopefully saving that Boot will come in handy later.

tutorial.line.B27b.2.text: But it's not all bad. Your Spiked Flail got stronger, too.

tutorial.line.B27c.1.text: Well done. You Kept your Boot and Breastplate, and you only lost 1 HP.

tutorial.line.B27c.2.text: Oftentimes, saving that one item or HP can mean the difference between survival and death in these dungeons.

tutorial.line.B28.1.text: Alright, let's Spin again and practice using some more interesting Items.

tutorial.line.B28a.1.text: Ooh, this will be fun. This Shark wants to devour you, but we've got better plans.

tutorial.line.B29.1.text: Remember those Fangs you picked up? Hover over it to see how they work.

tutorial.line.B29.2.text: When you use this Item, you let the enemy Attack you first, and then you Defeat them and gain HP equal to their health.

tutorial.line.B30.1.text: And look - Breastplate can help here. It can reduce incoming damage, so make sure you click it first.

tutorial.line.B30.2.text: Click on the Breastplate, just like before.

tutorial.line.B32.1.text: Everything worked perfectly! You Blocked 2 damage, lost 1 HP, then Healed 6.

tutorial.line.B32.3.text: And you Kept your Breastplate again.

tutorial.line.B32.4.text: Now that the Dungeon Deck is empty, this slice of the wheel simply closes.

tutorial.line.B32c.1.text: For this tutorial we kept empty seats open. This is how it will really look as you get down to the endgame.

tutorial.line.B32c.2.text: Only 3 enemies left now. Let's Spin and continue - this is gonna be easy!

tutorial.line.B34.1.text: Oops. Yeah, I may have lied a little.

tutorial.line.B34.2.text: These Harpies hit you the second you Spin onto them.

tutorial.line.B34.3.text: And again after every item you use while Facing them.

tutorial.line.B34a.1.text: Hmm - if we want to defeat these Harpies while minimizing damage, we need to think carefully about when we Spin and how we sequence our items.

tutorial.line.B35.1.text: Okay, she's got 5 HP. If we use any item that doesn't kill her, she will attack again.

tutorial.line.B35.2.text: Your Flail could one-shot her. But let's save that for now.

tutorial.line.B36.2.text: Let's use Arrow Head instead. This will do the trick.

tutorial.line.B38.1.text: Perfect. We Lost 2 HP from using Arrow Head, but at least she didn't Attack us again.

tutorial.line.B38.3.text: Uh oh. I made a huge mistake.

tutorial.line.B38a.1.text: The instant you Defeat an enemy, it will trigger the next Spin.

tutorial.line.B38aa.1.text: ...if that wheel Spins onto the other Harpy, she will kill you before you get a chance to react.

tutorial.line.B38aaa.1.text: Oh no, here comes the Spin...I can't look!

tutorial.line.B40.1.text: Whew! That was a close one! Okay, next time I promise I'll account for that possibility. That's my fault.

tutorial.line.B40.2.text: So we COULD kill this Dragon right now using your Spiked Flail. But if we do, we'll Spin onto the other Harpy and die.

tutorial.line.B40.3.text: Look at these arrows here - these allow you to [color=#6a3c00][b]Move 3[/b][/color] times per dungeon, left or right. They do NOT count as a [color=#6a3c00][b]Spin[/b][/color]. Let's try [color=#6a3c00][b]Moving[/b][/color] onto the Harpy and see what happens.

tutorial.line.B41.1.text: Great, it worked! Her ability did not activate. That's the power of Movement.

tutorial.line.B41.2.text: Now you're down to [color=#6a3c00][b]2 Moves[/b][/color] remaining - more than enough to finish this dungeon.

tutorial.line.B42.1.text: By my math, this Shield is enough to Defend against her Attacks. Let's use it.

tutorial.line.B47.3.text: Monsters with a red background are [b]Deadly[/b], and carry the strongest abilities. This Dragon's Attack completely ignores Block.

tutorial.line.B47.4.text: But, we saved a surprise tool for later that we can finally use.

tutorial.line.B49.1.text: Let's slay this dragon. End this.

tutorial.line.B50.1.text: Every choice can make or break you in these dungeons, so let me give you one last piece of advice:

tutorial.line.B50.2.text: Plan ahead. Find Item combos and Monster counters. Expect the best Spins...but prepare for the worst.

tutorial.line.B50.3.text: But for now, let's take you home. Or rather, to the new home you will inherit if you complete your grandfather's will. Come, let's go.
